description: TruReturing 公开猜想解决与反驳档案库：永久记录已形式化证明、反例反驳或障碍刻画的公开数学命题；前端同时自动并入实时观察到的最新已合入 Lean 证明与反驳记录。

entries.title: Rational Bloch tetrahedron obstruction
entries.zh_title: 有理 Bloch 四面体可实现性障碍（反驳 / 障碍）
entries.summary: 形式化证明有理 Bloch 四面体上的精确障碍条件，排除对应有理态构造的全局可行性。
entries.en_summary: Formally proves the exact obstruction on the rational Bloch tetrahedron, ruling out global realizability of the proposed rational-state construction.

entries.title: Two rational norm obstructions for diagonal Fibonacci marginals
entries.zh_title: 对角斐波那契边缘态的两类有理范数障碍
entries.summary: 完整刻画对角 Fibonacci 边缘态中导致有理扩展失效的两类精确范数障碍。
entries.en_summary: Characterizes two exact rational-norm obstructions that block rational extensions of diagonal Fibonacci marginal states.

entries.title: Generic divergence from separated dense real limsup classes
entries.zh_title: 分离稠密实上极限类的通有发散性（反例构造）
entries.summary: 证明由分离稠密实上极限类触发的通有发散现象，为收敛性边界提供严格反驳见证。
entries.en_summary: Proves generic divergence forced by separated dense real limsup classes, providing a formal refutation witness at the convergence boundary.

entries.title: Four-square witness at a maximally mixed endpoint
entries.zh_title: 最大混合端点的四平方反例见证
entries.summary: 在量子几何最大混合端点处构造显式四平方见证，区分有理保真度与有理坐标。
entries.en_summary: Constructs an explicit four-square witness at a maximally mixed quantum-geometry endpoint, separating rational fidelity from rational coordinates.

entries.title: All-integer square-root reserve constant (Robin)
entries.zh_title: 全整数平方根储备常数（Robin 方向）
entries.summary: 在 Lean 中完成 Robin 方向全整数平方根储备常数的严格形式化证明。
entries.en_summary: Formally certifies in Lean 4 the all-integer square-root reserve constant along the Robin inequality line.

entries.title: Sharp uniform conditioning of four-copy BMV Gram blocks
entries.zh_title: 四副本 BMV Gram 块的精确一致条件数
entries.summary: 形式化证明四副本 BMV Gram 块的紧致一致条件数上界与奇异三值谱下界。
entries.en_summary: Formally proves sharp uniform conditioning upper bounds and singular three-value spectral lower bounds for four-copy BMV Gram blocks.

entries.title: Exact complete graph constants and separated clique sums
entries.zh_title: 完全图精确常数与分离团和的形式化
entries.summary: 完成完全图精确极值常数与分离团和结构的 Lean 形式化证明。
entries.en_summary: Formalizes exact extremal complete-graph constants and separated clique-sum decompositions in Lean 4.

entries.title: Banach-valued pointwise and L1 Birkhoff ergodic limits
entries.zh_title: Banach 值逐点与 L¹ Birkhoff 遍历极限
entries.summary: 在有限测度空间上完成 Banach 值 Birkhoff 逐点与 L¹ 联合遍历极限的形式化证明。
entries.en_summary: Formally proves joint pointwise and L1 Banach-valued Birkhoff ergodic limits over finite measure spaces.

entries.title: Exact order-four unistochastic phase completion
entries.zh_title: 四阶酉随机矩阵精确相位补全
entries.summary: 完成四阶 unistochastic 相位补全问题的精确形式化刻画与证明。
entries.en_summary: Formally characterizes and proves exact phase completion for order-four unistochastic matrices.

entries.title: Sharp zero forcing numbers for the generalized Petersen graphs P(n,3) and P(n,4)
entries.zh_title: 广义 Petersen 图 P(n,3) 与 P(n,4) 的精确零强迫数
entries.summary: 确定广义 Petersen 图族 P(n,3) 与 P(n,4) 的精确零强迫数公式并公开预印本。
entries.en_summary: Establishes exact zero forcing number formulas for the generalized Petersen graph families P(n,3) and P(n,4).

entries.title: On the coincidence of discrete and continuous definitions of Entanglement of Formation
entries.zh_title: 形成纠缠的离散与连续定义等价性证明
entries.summary: 证明量子信息中形成纠缠（Entanglement of Formation）离散与连续定义的严格一致。
entries.en_summary: Proves the strict coincidence between the discrete and continuous definitions of Entanglement of Formation in quantum information.

entries.title: Canonical Zeckendorf Normalization and sharp iteration depth of the Berstel Adder
entries.zh_title: 规范 Zeckendorf 归约与 Berstel 加法器的精确迭代深度
entries.summary: 已正式发表于 RAIRO-ITA：给出 Berstel 加法器规范 Zeckendorf 归约的精确迭代深度界。
entries.en_summary: Published in RAIRO-ITA: establishes the sharp iteration depth bound for canonical Zeckendorf normalization via the Berstel adder.
